# tree2labels Python 3 compatibility modules

These files are a mechanical `2to3` conversion of `dataset.py`, `tree.py`, and
`utils.py` from the `external/tree2labels` submodule at commit
`edec9ae2d41aec799f88c8e76ccb9c34c45ea1d3`. Imports were made package-relative;
the parsing algorithms are otherwise unchanged.

The original source is by DVC and is distributed under the MIT license copied
in this directory. The pinned original checkout remains under `external/` for
provenance.
